test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A gives B a head-start of 10 seconds in a 1500 m race and both finish the race at the same time. What is the time taken by A (in minutes) to finish the race if speed of B is 6 m/s?
solution:
**Given:**

A gives B a head-start of 10 seconds in a 1500 m race and both finish the race at the same time

Speed of B = 6 m/s

**Concept Used:**

Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken by B to finish the race = (1500)/(6) = 250 s

⇒ Given A gives a head start of 10 seconds to B

⇒ Time taken by A to finish the race = 250 – 10 = 240 s

⇒ 1 minute = 60 seconds

⇒ So, 240 s = (240)/(60) = 4 minutes

**Therefore, the time taken by A to finish the race is 4 minutes.**
